targets.title: Banned marks and words
targets.what it will hold (proposed for step 8,: No em dashes, no semicolons, no emojis, never "my clients". Lint blocks delivery.

targets.title: His words stay his
targets.what it will hold (proposed for step 8,: Text he typed keeps its wording and tense. "" lines change at most a tenth. Keeper lines, brain quotes and locked names (Laws, tagline, coined terms) printed exactly. Doubt means ask, never change.

targets.title: True material only
targets.what it will hold (proposed for step 8,: Every fact traces to the brain or his published pieces. Transcripts only check facts. No invented biography, title, subtitle, citation, book claim or fact under his name. Missing material is marked, never filled.

targets.title: His method and his thesis
targets.what it will hold (proposed for step 8,: The method and the closing third come from the Law's own material. Argue his thesis, never the genre's or a book author's.

targets.title: Built-detail hard lines
targets.what it will hold (proposed for step 8,: R3b Never list plus R3 health and money: no better result or raised stakes, no past, no moved insight, no family scene, no unseen sensory detail, nothing no real person would do, no made-up research data, no condition, diagnosis, medicine, reading or weight, money only with a human side.

targets.title: Print names and hidden people
targets.what it will hold (proposed for step 8,: Print names from brain.personas only. Never a real client name or an identifying detail. Never-use material stays out.

targets.title: His stance
targets.what it will hold (proposed for step 8,: Everyone is resourceful. He is the editor, not the hero. Never diagnostic, pitying, know-it-all, or a label for the reader.

targets.title: One thread
targets.what it will hold (proposed for step 8,: Fill "this piece is about ____". Every beat makes the reader relate to their own ____ and moves the one thought, second half too. An idea owned elsewhere gets one callback at most.

targets.title: Joins answer the reader's question
targets.what it will hold (proposed for step 8,: The reader's question sits between paragraphs and the next first sentence answers it. Glue between beats. A switch of person or mode gets a bridge. The story-to-takeaway join ends the story first.

targets.title: Links are real
targets.what it will hold (proposed for step 8,: Each sentence takes something from the one before. So, then, because and but claim true relations. Repeat the words, never a far "it". Every sentence has an owner. A louder restatement is cut.

targets.title: Few names, one each
targets.what it will hold (proposed for step 8,: 2 or 3 things the reader must carry, each with one name every time.

targets.title: Nothing arrives bare
targets.what it will hold (proposed for step 8,: Show, then name, then say plainly. A surprising idea comes with its support. New ideas are explained plainly. One leap of logic per step, every step written. Lean only on what the reader brought or met earlier.

targets.title: Images from the reader's life
targets.what it will hold (proposed for step 8,: Imagery only on experiences the reader has lived. One image at a time. No made-up metaphor.

targets.title: One story, told once
targets.what it will hold (proposed for step 8,: One arc, told forward. A person's story told whole in one place, then only callbacks. No return trips, no retcons, no second arc in place of a cut one. Close loops by continuing the timeline.

targets.title: Stakes, not more story
targets.what it will hold (proposed for step 8,: A weak beat gets higher stakes, raised to what they really are, never more narrative. Show a claimed peril in a clause.

targets.title: Warm the water
targets.what it will hold (proposed for step 8,: A client line gets the facts the reader lacks first. A one-line quote gets more setup or runs longer. Every leap a session took for granted is served on the page. A case reaches beyond its one area of life.

targets.title: Research backs, never interrupts
targets.what it will hold (proposed for step 8,: Idea first in his words, then the study in 2 to 5 sentences, one finding, its meaning in a line. No year, no university, at most one name with a role. Never inside his story. The reader's words, not the paper's. No disclaimer paragraph.

targets.title: Built details serve the reader
targets.what it will hold (proposed for step 8,: Build only to answer a reader's question or hide the person. Each detail does work. One or two per gap. Border items only with their "unless". Every built detail listed in the end note.

targets.title: No meta-narration
targets.what it will hold (proposed for step 8,: Never explain the piece's shape. The book may signpost what the reader needs.

targets.title: Rhythm without choppiness
targets.what it will hold (proposed for step 8,: Short sentences have a job. One event, one sentence. Break a run of same-shape sentences with a long one. No clipped fragment runs. Fragments default to none.

targets.title: Parallels that truly match
targets.what it will hold (proposed for step 8,: Parallel frames only for matching items, with the frame and subject kept exact. A mirror needs matching beats and enough material.

targets.title: Plain words he would say
targets.what it will hold (proposed for step 8,: Concrete nouns the reader can see, touch or count. Plain at the mechanism. Spoken material rewritten as prose. Simple words for articles, letters and case studies, richer allowed in chapters.

targets.title: Protect the author
targets.what it will hold (proposed for step 8,: Being open and vulnerable is welcome, often good (his note, 5 Nov). Out: a line that reads against him out of context, such as a bad practice or a wealth flex. A moment that shows him unfinished sits in the past, unless it pays off a vulnerable build. /privileged lines made acceptable. Recognition, never credit for being first.

targets.title: Turns and endings
targets.what it will hold (proposed for step 8,: A section rises to one turn, then hands off. Prescriptive, not philosophical, at the hinge. Articles never end on the hard question alone. No teacher's summary in the prose.

targets.title: AI tells
targets.what it will hold (proposed for step 8,: No "Stop X. Start Y.", no "not just X. Y.", no cliché templates or hype words, no over-simplified prose, no cleverness the audience will not recognise.

targets.title: Mechanics fixed silently
targets.what it will hold (proposed for step 8,: British spelling, "everyday", Oxford comma, numbers per card, grammar in his voice. Lint fixes, never fails.

targets.title: Length and readability are guardrails
targets.what it will hold (proposed for step 8,: Length follows the material. Never pad, never compress steps. Numbers reported, never proof.

targets.title: Specific detail
targets.what it will hold (proposed for step 8,: Name books, places, brands, people, exact numbers. Name characters. A place name gets its category.

targets.title: Quoted self-talk
targets.what it will hold (proposed for step 8,: The reader's inner voice in quotes, first person. Placement per card (see clash C3).

targets.title: Raw emotion and real pressure
targets.what it will hold (proposed for step 8,: Small specific humiliations. Raw beats tasteful. External pressure and his themes.

targets.title: Lists and triplets
targets.what it will hold (proposed for step 8,: Three items from different areas of life. End on the callback. Vary the counts.

targets.title: Author presence
targets.what it will hold (proposed for step 8,: Warmth from his own short story. Calibrated confidence. Check in with the reader.

targets.title: Callbacks and staying close
targets.what it will hold (proposed for step 8,: After the turn, stay with the reader's life. Call back in exact words with a tag. Plant and pay off.

targets.title: People on the page
targets.what it will hold (proposed for step 8,: Case shape, exchanges told in prose, scenes set up with body, setting, inner voice and one chain of cause.

targets.title: Moves that work
targets.what it will hold (proposed for step 8,: Pattern bank: reveal in its own paragraph, presentize, short suspense, let the reader draw the line, directive with a concrete act, compression after setup, "similarly:", extended metaphor order, same-frame openers, contractions, "However" at a turn, building toward a genre-cliché word without naming it, his soft verb and coined terms for research.

targets.title: Reading his raw material
targets.what it will hold (proposed for step 8,: Cut hedges, keep vulnerability markers. Tell talking-out-loud from crafted lines. Read what a detail is evidence of.

targets.title: Built details you may use
targets.what it will hold (proposed for step 8,: R3b Allowed list (lines 21 to 32, 39): permissions, never musts.

targets.title: Article card
targets.what it will hold (proposed for step 8,: Inside The Introvert: 3 Insight fields, Insight 1 from him in first person, 600-word ballpark, readability band, digits, simple words, vocabulary diff, possibility coda, sign-off, Insight 3 question, no title until publish, Notion schema.

targets.title: Letter card
targets.what it will hold (proposed for step 8,: Article card plus: his realisation is the blank, told in the order it happened, the book only as setup, author named at first mention, the book checked before quoting, Insight 2 is the book layer, name and subtitle pattern.

targets.title: Chapter card
targets.what it will hold (proposed for step 8,: Book standard: Dweck and Clear point of view, book numbers and vocabulary, headings, opening story, one turn per section, summary box, From Within You, special line, figures, callbacks, default shape, end note, indent layout.

targets.title: Key moments card
targets.what it will hold (proposed for step 8,: 5 or 6 moments, each built 3 different ways and labelled, facts from the fact sheet, chapter rules per moment, visible paragraph gap.

targets.title: Case study card
targets.what it will hold (proposed for step 8,: The objective (reads like Dweck, sounds like him, inside the built-detail lines), case shape, warm water, built details, exchanges, length follows the story.

targets.title: coach-gen-writer rewrite (step 14)
targets.what it will hold (proposed for step 8,: Process: load the card, draft, lint, check, deliver.

targets.title: propose-language-rule (step 16)
targets.what it will hold (proposed for step 8,: Rule-change process, admission test, wording format, test-set gate.

targets.title: Guardrails and new project instructions (step 17)
targets.what it will hold (proposed for step 8,: Working rules that are not about the writing.

targets.title: Project or account memory (step 19)
targets.what it will hold (proposed for step 8,: Working style that stays in memory.

targets.title: Rules table in the brain (step 9)
targets.what it will hold (proposed for step 8,: Protection, never-delete trigger and change log replace protection by instruction.

targets.title: Reference the cards point to
targets.what it will hold (proposed for step 8,: Corpus list, worked examples, reference shelf, provenance.

targets.title: Calibration log or archive only
targets.what it will hold (proposed for step 8,: History. Kept in archive/pre-prune and git, not loaded with the rules.

targets.title: Stays in its own skill
targets.what it will hold (proposed for step 8,: Tool rules that live with the tool (rhyme-this, other skills).

targets.title: Stays in Social Posting Rules
targets.what it will hold (proposed for step 8,: Out of scope until a social card is built (deferred).

targets.title: Stays in Reel Style Guide
targets.what it will hold (proposed for step 8,: Out of scope (deferred).

targets.title: Stays in brand docs
targets.what it will hold (proposed for step 8,: Out of scope (deferred).

targets.title: Stays in Content Rules
targets.what it will hold (proposed for step 8,: Out of scope (deferred).

targets.title: Open, his call
targets.what it will hold (proposed for step 8,: Not placed until he decides.

flags.problem: Number quotas: short sentences "1 in 7 to 1 in 5", a heading "every 400 to 600 words", "at least one long winding sentence". The model hits the number and misses the job
flags.proposed fix: Keep the job, drop the numbers (lint may report them)

flags.problem: Exact parallel frames and same-frame paragraph openers. This push made round 3 "robotic and repeated", and it fights R13 (break a run)
flags.proposed fix: Parallel only when items truly match. Drop R12a

flags.problem: "Carry every case into another area of life" as a Tier 1 must adds a boilerplate "this works for X, Y, Z" paragraph after every case and fights R39. From one article
flags.proposed fix: Tier 2, use it when a case is narrow

flags.problem: Praised passages written as patterns (the force paragraph, "similarly:", the structural moves list, the ages series). Loud examples get copied into every draft (plan cause 6)
flags.proposed fix: Move them to the style bank as examples

flags.problem: Angry quotes inside rule text make the model over-apply that one rule
flags.proposed fix: Quotes go to the evidence column. The rule line stays calm

flags.problem: A banned-word list from one draft (circuit, variable, reasonable, eventually and more). The model swaps synonyms and keeps the abstract sentence
flags.proposed fix: Drop the list. The concrete-noun rule does the job

flags.problem: Claude scores its own draft before delivery. It gave 7.5 to the epoch he nearly dropped
flags.proposed fix: Blind checkers replace it. His scorecard stays

flags.problem: "Warmth is the author's own story, right after a case." With no story for that spot in the brain, the model invents biography or forces an "I, too"
flags.proposed fix: Only from the brain, never a quota

flags.problem: Vocabulary diff against six March to May articles. The target is now book standard, and the corpus has to be rebuilt from Notion each time
flags.proposed fix: His call: (a) drop it (b) keep it for articles

flags.problem: Article-only splits (digits, self-talk on its own line, 600 ballpark, readability band). Articles now feed chapters, so each split is rework later
flags.proposed fix: His call: (a) one convention for everything (b) keep the splits

flags.problem: The short-form track: [short-form] tags, storyboards, the 5x5x5 brainstorm. Its skill (content-from-article) is gone and its log is empty
flags.proposed fix: His call: (a) retire it (b) keep it for a future content card

flags.problem: Worksheet rules (verbatim transcription, "everything in build_worksheet.js is real"). The brain replaced the worksheet
flags.proposed fix: Verbatim rule to the mine skill. Drop the worksheet line

flags.problem: Reading raw material (cut hedges, spot talking-out-loud, read what a detail is evidence of). Writers now take mined gold from the brain
flags.proposed fix: Move to the mine skill

flags.problem: "3-act structure for articles" against R31 (never an act) and one arc per piece
flags.proposed fix: His call: (a) drop it (b) keep it, meaning a series in 3 parts

flags.problem: "David's case may be split into several people" (7 Oct). Chapter 3 now tells David's arc once (R38)
flags.proposed fix: His call: (a) retire it (b) keep it

flags.problem: "Call him X, and disclose it in the citation layer" predates brain.personas and the anonymity line
flags.proposed fix: Print names from brain.personas. The anonymity line covers it

flags.problem: "Everyday" as one word. As an adverb ("every day") that is a grammar mistake, and R15 says fix grammar
flags.proposed fix: "Everyday" only as an adjective. His own typed words stay

flags.problem: Rules that point at a book passage by line ("like Courage's narrator, CG 254 to 262"). The writer cannot see those lines
flags.proposed fix: Spell out the moves. Line references to the evidence column

flags.problem: Unconfirmed Claude readings sitting inside rules ("Claude's reading, to confirm on epoch 4")
flags.proposed fix: Cut until he confirms

flags.problem: The built-detail list opens with 8 lines that say "limits, not musts" three ways
flags.proposed fix: 3 lines

flags.rows: BR (most of sections A to G)
flags.problem: Evidence inside rule text: "His words", "Support", measurements, [5 of 5] tags, dated "(Added ... at his request)" lines. Most of the Book Rules' bulk
flags.proposed fix: Evidence column. The card loads the rule lines only

flags.problem: Notes about non-rules ("Edition 1 had a beat ... not a rule", "confirm with him if...", "this is not a rule")
flags.proposed fix: Cut

flags.problem: Extended metaphor rules (rarely used) and his themes (content, not craft)
flags.proposed fix: Themes to the brain. Metaphor lines cut, "one image per beat" stays

flags.problem: Too-heavy and too-light diagnosis paragraphs, the named-things-per-100-words metric
flags.proposed fix: One line: numbers catch gross failure only. Drop the metric

flags.problem: Status notes inside rules ("the build doesn't handle figures yet")
flags.proposed fix: To the handoff

flags.problem: Answered items still marked open or proposed (Reel open items, Taste "not stated yet", Voice "approve or strike")
flags.proposed fix: Cut the stale labels when those cards are built

flags.problem: The Tier 2 pattern bank (about 25 small moves) never fails a draft but would load every time
flags.proposed fix: Tier 0 and 1 always. A few Tier 2 lines per card. The rest in the style bank

flags.problem: "Protect the author" read vulnerability as looking bad. His note (5 Nov): the two are a thin line AI often gets wrong, and vulnerability is fine, even good
flags.proposed fix: Reword T1.16 (decision page, card 24)
